n-log.text: Live log needs indah: E1 push channel (rows within 1 s), E2 table v2 (append-only stream, row renderers), E6 resizable master-detail, E3 collapsible JSON viewer. Needs semula: a redacted prompt preview on each call_log row, and log stats.

n-pending.text: Pending needs indah: E1 push (new parked call, rail count), E3 multiline editor with JSON mode, E7 dynamic rows (tool arguments, stream chunks), E5 toast for validation errors.

n-entries.text: Entries needs indah: E2 table v2 (ids not indexes, server paging and filter, cell renderers, multi-select), E4 deep links, E5 badges and switch. Needs semula: list filters and flags.

n-entry.text: Entry editor needs indah: E3 code editor with JSON modes and a diff, E5 confirm dialog and toast, E7 dynamic answer list, E4 deep link. Needs semula: entry history for Compare.

n-review.text: Review needs indah: E3 side-by-side word diff (the hardest ask), E5 keyboard shortcuts for approve, reject and next, E2 list with live count, E6 resizable panes.

n-play.text: Playground needs indah: E7 dynamic message stack and tool rows, E3 JSON viewer, E5 switch and tooltip. The tier rail is custom: E8 theme tokens plus a slot for it. Needs semula: a verdict for every tier in test_match.

n-hosted.text: Hosted needs indah H1 identity in context, H2 login with CSRF and Origin checks, H3 roles per workspace, H6 token UI, H7 base-path support. How well these land decides indah versus Svelte + Vite + TypeScript.

n-key.text: Dashed outline: exists only in the hosted version. Dark boards are the same screens with the theme set to dark.
